objective: Make the Pi integration tests remove their temporary folders reliably on Windows, so a folder still briefly held by an exited child process no longer fails the suite with EBUSY.
scope: Observed on the Windows CI runner (job log at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-holyagent/43946df6-456d-58c6-bea3-7e958fcb9495/scratchpad/win100.log, around line 2700): packages/integrations/pi/tests/extension.test.ts:863 `await done()` failed with `EBUSY: resource busy or locked, rm 'C:\\Users\\RUNNER~1\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\holyagent-pi-real-85cIwo'` in test 'with the built package and a real project > a bad .holyagent/config.json is reported with the field it names'. All assertions before the cleanup passed. Windows holds a directory handle for a short while after a child process that used it as cwd exits, so a single rm races it.

Fix the temporary-folder cleanup in packages/integrations/pi/tests: removal retries on EBUSY, EPERM and ENOTEMPTY (for example node:fs/promises rm with recursive, force, maxRetries and retryDelay, or the equivalent the repository already uses elsewhere), through one shared helper if several tests in that folder clean up the same way. Check the other cleanups in that folder and give them the same helper.
If packages/runtime/tests already has such a helper, reuse its approach but do not edit packages/runtime/tests (another change owns it); name it in the report.

result:
result: All 31 temp-folder cleanups in the Pi tests now go through one retrying helper. I could not run it on Windows, so the helper is tested only against a fake remover.

changed (all under /home/user/holyagent-0.3.1-rmfix/packages/integrations/pi/tests):
temp-folder.ts (new): `removeTemporary(path, remove = rm, retryDelayMs = 100)`. It calls `rm` with recursive and force, retries up to 10 attempts on EBUSY, EPERM and ENOTEMPTY with a 100 ms delay, and rethrows anything else.
temp-folder.test.ts (new): 3 tests of the helper against a fake remover. They cover retry on all three codes, no retry on EACCES, and giving up with the last error when the folder stays busy.
contract.test.ts, extension.test.ts, pi.test.ts and session-context.test.ts: every `rm(x, { recursive: true, force: true })` is now `removeTemporary(x)`. The `rm` imports are dropped. No assertion changed and no test skipped.

checks:
`bunx --no-install mise run build` -> exit 0, no generated-output changes, only the six paths above in `git status`.
`bunx --no-install mise run verify` -> exit 0, 2706 pass, 0 fail, 88 files. The first run failed lint on an `async` arrow in the new test; I fixed it and re-ran.
The EBUSY race itself cannot be reproduced on Linux.

notes:
packages/runtime/tests has no shared helper. Several files use `rm(..., { recursive: true, force: true, maxRetries: 5 })` (cli, host, stdin) and others use a bare `rm`. I did not edit them. The owner of that change could reuse the idea of `removeTemporary`, or import it from the Pi tests folder.
I wrote an explicit retry loop instead of `rm`'s `maxRetries` and `retryDelay`, because I did not confirm that Bun retries on all three codes.
